sources.description: Small portrait card with a slightly tilted narrow gray photo frame, dark outer surround/shadow, and preserved cool blue-gray photographic backing inside the frame. A pale beige rectangular note overlaps the right foreground, covering the right shoulder and part of that side of the face; it retains two short rows of indistinct dark marks near its upper edge. Transparency belongs only outside the complete card/note silhouette; the photograph backing, face, cloth and note stay solid. Exact original is 65x67, actual alpha extrema0..255. The near-frontal elderly person has a mostly bare rounded crown with very sparse short gray-brown hair at the sides, dark-gray brows, thin round spectacles across both eyes, prominent ears, a long narrow nose, and a calm faint closed-mouth smile. No hat is visible. A white/pale gray cloth wraps and drapes around the shoulders and base of the neck, with a darker central chest/neck opening; retain the real cloth folds and opening rather than substituting a suit, tie or uniform. Tight head-and-upper-shoulders crop with forehead/nose highlights, darker cheek/neck shadows and the original lighting. Preserve the source pose, gaze and expression while adapting a compact yellow mascot head and short broad neck to the original draped clothing. Exact original, full nearest-neighbor12x and unchanged user mascot reference were actually viewed. Evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: the tiny pale/dark upper-lip pixels do not securely distinguish a separate narrow gray moustache from skin/nose/lip shading; do not claim that feature was proved present or absent or invent a substantial beard. visible-alpha-v1 retains actual alpha values and requires no visible holes or missing backing. No larger source was substituted.
